Source: API Card
api: d2i_X509
library: openssl
family: der_parser
signature: X509 *d2i_X509(X509 **a, const unsigned char **ppin, long length)
parameter_semantics: a: optional reuse/output object pointer
ppin: input DER pointer, advanced to consumed object end on success
length: available input length
return_value_semantics: success: returns X509 object pointer
failure: returns NULL
valid_invalid_ranges: valid: complete DER X.509 certificate object
invalid: malformed ASN.1 certificate structure
unsupported_conditions: - caller expecting whole-input validation without checking "*ppin == end"
mutation_hints: - trailing garbage
- malformed second object
- oversized length
- truncated inner ASN.1 field
oracle_observables: - parse_success
- consumed_len
- trailing_len
- caller_accept
notes: - 'Known pitfall: d2i_* low-level APIs may advance the pointer only to the consumed
  object.'
- Whole-input callers should check p == end.
